dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Adds repeatable name/ID flags, clear conflicts, a repeated-field example, and retains the no-selection path.
evidence: product.diff (item_list.go flag, PreRunE, runList, and Example hunks)

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution, canonical headers, and actionable unknown-field errors are present. Ambiguous IDs follow supplied field order without explicit sorting, so cross-response deterministic ordering is not established.

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Selected-field requests reuse field definitions from the item query and paginate only when the field connection has another page.
evidence: product.diff: ProjectItemsWithFields, projectItems, and appendProjectFieldPages hunks

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: Covers required scalar, structured, and multi-value renderers; unmatched values are empty and CR/LF is normalized.

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Canonical headers and ID-matched values append in requested order; each selected field adds a cell, preserving alignment when missing.
evidence: product.diff: runList, printResults, and itemFieldValue hunks

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution and pagination errors return before rendering; the change uses existing project query types and leaves unselected behavior on the prior path.
evidence: product.diff: runList and projectItems error-return hunks

criticalGaps: Ambiguous field-ID candidates are not explicitly sorted; deterministic ordering across arbitrary field-definition response order is unverified.
